review: Rosespanner powercreep. T Corp Rodion is an ID that does a lot of things, but firstly her numbers go from 11/14/14. This may not be impressive at first but on conditionals - Borrowed Time and Time Moratorium - this can go up to 17/20/24 which is already above average. Now Borrowed Time can be triggered by using the defensive skills, meaning you will have 1 dead turn where you won't do anything in exchange for Haste and Clash Power up for 2 turns (turn end subtraction). But also Fragile which can make her be shredded cheese in certain fights when you cannot Clash or overwhelmed with numbers. With the one dead turn in mind, it is ideal to use a guard on turns where you are forced to use s1 to not lose out on the value.
